name: Anomaly Center
storyline:
You are Caleb Hitchman
"Your role is simple: Watch the cameras, report shoplifters... That's pretty much it." - Manager
As luck would have it, gruesome events took place at the shopping mall - events in which YOU happen to play the lead role. On your very first night, your true intentions come to light.
A mysterious organization known as DAC (Detect, Analyze, Contain, Exterminate) contacts you to assign a job you cannot refuse. They know your past and they know what you're after. Either you cooperate, or you suffer the consequences.

Become a Pawn in Someone Else's Game
Forced to work for DAC, the standard duties of a security guard quickly take a backseat. Your new objective is to spot Anomalies that began haunting the building following an unsolved murder from a week prior.
Watch the cameras: Switch between 1980s analog CCTV feeds and keep an eye out for anything out of the ordinary.
Control the situation: Don't let the number of Anomalies exceed safe limits. Otherwise, your shift will come to an end - forever.
Uncover the dark truth: Step into Caleb's shoes, reveal his secrets, and find out if you're truly just an accidental employee.
summary: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.
